messages.content: Reach the green exit safely. Coordinates [x,z] in meters; east increases x, south increases z. Walls are [xmin,zmin,xmax,zmax]. Heading in radians from east toward south. Movement is cardinal at 2.5 m/s until blocked; WAIT holds position. Avoid patrol contact and unobstructed 90 degree, 5 m patrol vision. All patrols are shown at the current decision time. The clock stops during decisions. Choose one listed action and duration. Return plain JSON {"action":"...","duration":0.5,"reason":"short English reason"}. North/south decrement/increment z; west/east decrement/increment x. Player radius 0.28 m. Movement clips against closed wall rectangles expanded by that radius on both axes. Robot radius 0.34 m. Patrols continue while waiting and moving; each 0.01 s substep checks swept contact (center separation ≤0.62 m), then detection, before exit. Detection needs center distance ≤5 m, heading difference ≤45 degrees and an unobstructed center-to-center segment; touching a wall blocks that ray. Either event immediately ends the attempt. You receive every patrol ID, position and heading only at decision boundaries. No mid-action observation or cancellation. Terminal feedback gives outcome, not detector ID. Reach within 0.64 m of exit center.
